newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Prices mixed, volumes light on Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Prices mixed, volumes light on Bucharest bourse.

text.p: Bucharest shares traded mixed on Tuesday with volumes keeping low and turnover rising a scant 4.6 million lei to 58.7 million.
"We expected most prices to touch new lows today, but bids rose under low selling offer," one trader said.
Four stocks climbed, four slipped, three were flat and two had no trade.
"Interest in the market was thin today and volumes stayed thin, with demand focusing on Azomures and Artrom ARTM.BX, which proved the most liquid," said another trader.
Azomures state fertiliser maker took 79 percent of overall turnover. It closed 700 lei stronger at 11,200.
Some 1,300 of the total 7,260 shares traded were Artrom's. The engineer gained 200 lei, closing at 2,350.
Brokers said they expected trading on the Bursa de Valori Bucuresti to pick up soon as more companies planned to get a listing and join the market.
The exchange confirmed on Tuesday some six stocks were ready to enter the bourse but declined to give more details.

Two independent value-weighted indices on Tuesday showed rises from the previous session. The VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities company, and the BIG, compiled by Bucharest Investment Group SA brokerage house were 3.2 percent up. Their base was 1,000 points last November.
